g.text: Owner: its lane, its steps and the flows they start
Agent: its lane, its steps and the flows they start
QA agent: its lane, its steps and the flows they start
thick border: a step drawn in its own diagram
person icon: a step done by hand
diamond: one answer is taken; a loop returns through an unnamed one
